name: Flow Calligraphy
desc: Generative ink calligraphy where brush agents integrate along a slow curl-noise flow field, laying swelling and tapering variable-width strokes that accumulate into flowing glyph-like marks before the ink washes away and new gestures are written.

turb.doc: curl vortex strength (0 laminar, high chaotic)

wash.doc: how fast old ink washes away
